notes: Developed by flowfreq following the USGS GLS procedure (WREG). Regions are hydrologic-unit sets: {"1708": "W", "1709": "W", "1710": "W", "180101": "W", "171003": "W-171003", "170701": "E-170701", "170800": "W-170800", "170900": "W-170900"}; any other HUC is region E. Variable codes name their sources (PRISM 1991-2020 normals, NOAA Atlas 2, 3DEP): values of same-named StreamStats characteristics are not interchangeable. See docs/OREGON_REGRESSION_UPDATE.md.
